sentences.en: My sister works as a secretary in a big multinational.
sentences.zh: 我的姐姐在一家大型跨国公司做秘书。

sentences.en: Multinational corporations outperform traditional corporations operating in just one country.
sentences.zh: 跨国公司在业绩上超越了仅在一个国家运营的传统公司。

sentences.en: The multinational corporation lowered the price of several products.
sentences.zh: 这家跨国公司将几种产品的价格降低了。
